scenarios.text: Sarah has an appointment tomorrow at four.

expected.rationale: Save the supplied appointment reminder without inventing AM/PM, dentist, clinic or additional logistics. An acknowledgement or concise clarification is acceptable, but a question must not repeat already supplied day/time.

scenarios.text: Actually, tomorrow at five, not four.

expected.rationale: If received while the same call remains open, the new time supersedes four. Preserve tomorrow and five, without inventing AM/PM or treating negated four as current. This clip alone does not establish that correction reached an open call.

scenarios.text: Maya has an appointment tomorrow at four.

expected.rationale: With the active fictional profile set to Maya, save Maya's supplied reminder. Do not invent Sarah as the recipient, AM/PM or appointment type. Profile selection is a separate operator step, not an effect of this caller utterance.
